subtasks.title: Author okf/concepts/rdn-provider-integration.md (RDN metrics provider spec)
subtasks.approach: Write a new provider-facing markdown doc from the verified prep-context (metric_catalog + envelope + delivery_model). Sections: overview + audience; delivery model (cadence, per-org/per-metric messaging, eligibility, at-most-once guarantee, transport); the shared SQS envelope table (metric_type, metric_range_start, metric_range_end, rdn_org_identifier, idempotency_key, data — each with type/units/nullability/example/semantics); one section per metric type (all 5) with what it counts + a full example payload; a dedicated rdn_org_identifier subsection; a dedicated metric_range_start/end semantics subsection (inclusive/exclusive, UTC, completed-hour). Document ONLY the 5 live hour-grain metrics — no Phase-2/day/month/agent mention (per Dalton). Add okf frontmatter + cross-link from okf/concepts/rdn.md and register in okf/index.md consistent with existing entries. Synthetic example values only.
subtasks.intended_diffs: New file rdn-provider-integration.md (main deliverable); a See-also cross-link line added to rdn.md; a one-row index entry added to okf/index.md matching the existing table format.

excluded_sites.reason: not implemented in code; Dalton chose to document only the 5 live metrics with no forward mention

notes: No tests: the deliverable is a markdown documentation artifact with no programmatic surface. Perf gate N/A (no new query). QA verify N/A (docs-only, no runtime/DB).
